reviews.t: Quality is not what it used to be, will not buy again.
reviews.x: I have ordered these before and the quality has done a definite nose-dive. They are smaller, thinner, and now overly absorbant. Product, even thicker product like cream to powder, soaks through to the other side almost immediately. They are now actually flimsy and I would be better off with cosmetic sponges from the dollar store than these. I will use what I have left in the open bag in a limited capacity and give the unopened bags to a friend's teen daughter. I will not buy these again.

reviews.t: Didn't work for make-up or paint
reviews.x: I was going to use these for painting glass, but the pores in the sponge are just too big for that kind of application. So I used them for make-up, and found that the pore size in the sponge was an issue. It seemed to soak up the foundation and I had to use twice as much.

reviews.t: Ultra cheap quality, not worth a penny
reviews.x: So cheap, so thin, so flimsy..... these look like they would be the good quality wedges, but....noooooooo.....they are ultra squishy, ultra cheap, ultra useless. I couldn't even use them for painting because my fingers got all full of paint because they have no substance. Shouldve returned, but I just opened them this morning.  Lesson learned.

reviews.t: What a joke! These are for looks only!
reviews.x: I’m not sure what these could be used for but they can not be used for applying cosmetics. These sponges are a complete waste of money.  The seller should edit the product description to reflect that these are for looks only!

reviews.t: Not reusable. Flimsy. Cosmetics absorb into wedges.
reviews.x: USER'S REVIEW: Not for multiple use. Do not recommend washing and reusing. Your cosmetics will absorb into the wedges. They are flimsy. I did not return them and will continue to use them. They do work in applying cosmetics.

reviews.t: These are small and very flimsy. I used one ...
reviews.x: These are small and very flimsy. I used one and it started to break up while applying foundation. I ended up returning them.

Great value for the money, absorbency will be great for the crafting projects that I do. I decided to use wedge shaped cosmetic sponges to make background scenes on the handmade stamped greeting cards that I make. I tried other things to do that brushes, ink pad tools but they never gave me the look or coverage I wanted. Also great to use with stencils. I had some old ones unused from my makeup days and decided to use them for that instead. As for durability time will tell.

reviews.t: Looks like I got the "Bad Kind"
reviews.x: Apparently there are two types of these sponges: One that is a bit more dense, whiter, and cuts easily, and then there's one that has bigger holes, is slightly more yellow, and crumbles more easily. I got the second kind and I am not as happy as I could be. They are dirt cheap so I guess I'll still use them, but if I need to order more, I will try to get the other kind. Thanks Sir Wappel!

I thought these would be great for foundation shade matching in my makeup store.  Unfortunately these are really flimsy and soft sponges, with way too many air pockets, so they absorb way too much product which seeps through and soils my fingers.  Very unsanitary for this purpose.  I can't imagine what these could be used for so they will be tossed out.

These are probably the worst sponges I have ever used.  I typically use makeup sponges for painting.  My normal brand was out of stock so this came up as a recommendation.  Honestly, I would have rather gone without.  These are so thin and flimsy and basically sucks up the paint instead of keeping it on the surface.  Find a different alternative.

Absolutely do not buy. Horrible product. Typically make up wedges are a little rubbery feeling so the liquid foundation can sit on top, but these are so porous and absorb all the foundation. Does not work for applying make up at all. Stick with your tried and true wedges and don’t experiment with these.

I am a professor in and professional Makeup artist in Theatre. These sponges crumble, they are SO soft they won’t pickup makeup, it is almost impossible to spread makeup. My students won’t use them. They are basically garbage. I had to go out and purchase something else for us to use. A WASTE of money

This is a very small piece with no stability to them at all. They absorb all of your product so you end up using twice as much. Since my return time has lapsed, I had waited to use when I ran out of drug store brand, I’ll be throwing in the trash.

Package came on time. I recieved what was in the picture. The quality of the item was not what I hoped, feeling like a foam art brush. Not good for cosmetics. I will have to use these for an art project. They absorb all of my foundation.

These are a great deal. I bought them for painting wood signs. My only complaint is they tend to disintegrate quickly. I have others that are more like a foam that hold together. But for small projects these are great.

I used to buy a sturdier sponge but can no longer get it in bulk. I use this to spread my liquid makeup on my face each morning, but I find it way too absorbent. More makeup soaks into the sponge than gets on my face.

At first I did not think I would like them. Foam wedges I normally buy are somewhat firm, and these are super soft and squishy. But with sensitive skin, I find these are very nice to use. I will purchase again.

These are more like foam instead of a sponge. I use these for putting on face lotion and makeup and the “sponge” was not durable enough for one use. Definitely do not recommend. Will not be purchasing again.

These little sponges are too absorbent and use up your foundation super fast. I like that they're biodegradable, but in retrospect I don't want to compost something that has makeup on it. They work though.

I never write reviews. But these were awful. Too flimsy to put makeup on with. They kept balling up. they also have a strong odor to them. I will have to just throw them away. Don' t waste your money!
These sponges are thin and are cheaply made. Whatever you are applying, it does not absorb well and smooth on your skin well. They crumble and leave little pieces of sponge on your face.
I ordered this knowing it had some bad reviews and now I regret not listening to those reviews. These sponges are not dense and pieces are cut so small. I do not recommend these sponges

reviews.t: I didn’t like these sponges at all. Not for the professional artist.
reviews.x: I didn’t like these sponges at all. They are tiny and flimsy. They are definitely not for pro use and I couldn’t use them at home for my own makeup application.
It eats tour make up and breaks apart while trying to apply make up! Complete waste of money! Used once with utter disappointment and threw them away!!!!!
They arrived so fast  In perfect condition. They are your basic wedges I bought them for arts and crafts. They will serve me well for a very long time

claims.text: Many reviewers find the sponges overly absorbent, soaking up foundation, paint, or other products and forcing them to use more.
Reviewers frequently describe the sponges as thin, flimsy, and lacking substance or stability.
Several reviewers report the sponges crumble, break up, or disintegrate during use.
Some reviewers say the sponges are too porous or have pores/air pockets too large for makeup or paint application.
A few reviewers praise the value for money and find them useful for crafting or painting projects.
